workflows.description: Preferred top-level workflow whenever a user asks to search, inspect, or read Gmail/email messages and represent papers found there. It owns bounded mail discovery, full-message paper extraction including bare title mentions, all-paper iteration, source provenance, represented markers, and Gmail label/finality read-back. Choose this parent instead of directly listing Gmail and launching arXiv or source-neutral paper workflows; those are child capabilities after email discovery. Messages with no identifiable paper receive one actor-scoped review task and remain in Inbox. The parent preserves a result row for every discovered message and retryable details for independently failed items.

workflows.display_name: Email Arxiv Ingestion From Message Workflow
workflows.description: Processes one exact Gmail message selected by the caller: establish versioned source and processing-authority identity, reuse or upgrade current represented source-processing evidence when possible, identify every scientific paper including a bare title mention, ingest each reference through the source-neutral paper workflow, canonically verify every represented artefact, then atomically apply VON/PAPER/REPRESENTED and remove INBOX with independent Gmail read-back. If no supported paper reference is found, create or reuse one actor-scoped review task, apply VON/PAPER/NEEDS_REVIEW, and preserve INBOX.

static_input_bindings.template: Von found no identifiable scientific paper reference in Gmail message {message_id} from profile {profile}. Review the source message and decide whether its paper reference needs representation or the message should be skipped.

static_input_bindings.next_checkpoint: Review the Gmail source and either repair its paper representation or apply VON/PAPER/SKIP.
static_input_bindings.notes: The source message remains in Inbox. VON/PAPER/NEEDS_REVIEW removes it from automatic ingestion selection without claiming that it was represented.

workflows.description: Fetches one Gmail message through the generic workflow MCP bridge and uses the Vontology-authored output_item_signal_extraction_hint on #V#gmail_get_message_tool to identify every distinct scientific paper, including a bare title mention, as source-neutral structured paper references.

workflows.display_name: Arxiv Resource Ingestion From Email Reference Workflow
workflows.description: Converges one arXiv resource reference discovered from email. It first reads the canonical stable arXiv paper identity and reuses an existing represented paper when present; otherwise it delegates to #V#arxiv_paper_representation_workflow. The email-source convergence path succeeds once the paper representation concept is available; heavier paper reading and claim extraction belong in separate enrichment workflows.
